record.reason: RAST-MoE-RL is a policy/representation framework for ride-hailing dispatch trained with reinforcement learning. Its MoE experts serve urban demand regimes and improve matching/pickup outcomes; it does not address LLMs, language generation, or LLM inference efficiency.
record.title: RAST-MoE-RL: A Regime-Aware Spatio-Temporal MoE Framework for Deep Reinforcement Learning in Ride-Hailing
